## Introduction




## Data preparations

```{r}

# Libraries
library(AOData)
library(tidyverse)
library(brms)
library(marginaleffects)

# Data sets

# Glucose
glucose_dat <- AOData::glucose %>%
  select(participant:glucose) %>%
  print()

# Grouping
AOData::idkeys %>%
  select(participant, treat) %>%
  print()


```



## Preliminary models

### Baseline model with group-level effects (participants)



```{r}

# Use a complete data set (no missing data) at time 1 to set up models
pre_dat <- glucose_dat %>%
  filter(time == "T1") %>%
  filter(!(is.na(glucose))) %>%
  mutate(stglucose = (glucose - mean(glucose)) / sd(glucose), 
         participant = as.factor(participant)) %>%
  # To avoid problems, dropping participants with less than 7 
  # measurements
  mutate(.by = participant, 
         n = n()) %>%
  filter(n == 7)
  



pre_dat %>%
  group_by(participant) %>%
  summarise(n = n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  summarise(n.participants = n(), 
            avg.samples = mean(n), 
            min.samples = min(n)) 



```




```{r}

# Get priors 
f1 <- bf(stglucose ~ 1 + s(min, bs = "tp", k = 7) + 
            s(min, by = participant, m = 1, bs = "tp", k = 7) + 
            (1 | participant))


get_prior(f1, 
          family = gaussian(),
          data = pre_dat)

# Set priors

p1 <- c(prior(normal(-1, 1.5), class = Intercept), 
        prior(normal(0, 1), class = b, coef = "smin:participant_1"), 
        prior(normal(0, 1), class = b, coef = "smin_1"), 
        prior(exponential(1), class = sd),
        prior(normal(2, 2), class = sds, lb = 0), 
        prior(exponential(1), class = sigma))

validate_prior(p1, formula = f1, data = pre_dat)

# Prior predictive simulation

m1_pp <- brm(stglucose ~ 1 + s(min, bs = "tp", k = 7) + 
            s(min, by = participant, m = 1, bs = "tp", k = 7) + 
            (1 | participant),
              prior = p1, 
             file = "fits/ogtt-analysis/m1_pp", # Save the model
             sample_prior = "only", # Sample only from the prior
             data = pre_dat, 
             family = gaussian(),
             iter = 2000, 
             warmup = 1000, 
             control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95))


conditional_smooths(m1_pp)

```



```{r}




preds_prior <- predictions(m1_pp, 
                           newdata = expand_grid(min = seq(0, 120, 5), 
                                                 participant = c(1, 2, 3)), 
            allow_new_levels = TRUE)

posterior_draws(preds_prior) %>%
  filter(drawid %in% 1:500) %>%
  ggplot(aes(min, 
             draw, 
             group = paste(drawid, participant), 
             color = as.factor(participant))) + 
  geom_line(alpha = 0.1) + 

  labs(title = "Prior predictive simulation",
       x = "Sample time",
       y = "Glucose (standardized)") 



```



```{r}


## Fitting model 1

m1 <- update(m1_pp, 
             newdata = pre_dat, 
             sample_prior = "no", # Sample from the posterior
             file = "fits/ogtt-analysis/m1", 
             iter = 2000, 
             warmup = 1000, 
             control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95))



plot(m1)
print(m1)

```



```{r}

nd <- expand_grid(min = seq(0, 120, 5), 
                  participant = pull(distinct(pre_dat,participant), participant)) 


preds <- predictions(m1, newdata = nd) 


posterior_draws(preds) %>%
  filter(drawid %in% 1:500) %>%
  filter(participant %in% c("501", "503", "504", "506")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(min, draw, group = paste0(participant,drawid))) + 
  
  
  geom_line(alpha = 0.1, aes(color = as.factor(participant))) + 
  
  geom_point(data = filter(pre_dat, participant %in% c("501", "503", "504", "506")), 
             aes(min, stglucose, group = NULL, 
                 fill = as.factor(participant)), 
             alpha = 1, shape = 21, size = 2) +
  
  geom_smooth(method="lm", se=FALSE, color = "black", linetype = "dashed",
              aes(min, stglucose, group = participant),
             data = filter(pre_dat, participant %in% c("501", "503", "504", "506")), 
   formula =  y ~ splines::bs(x, df = 4)) +
  
  
  labs(title = "Posterior predictive simulation (Global and participant specific smooths)",
       subtitle = "Posterior draws as lines per participant, data as points",
       x = "Sample time (min)",
       y = "Glucose (Standardized units)") + 
  theme_classic()  +  facet_wrap(~ participant)

```



### Non-penalized splines

```{r}
library(splines)

get_prior(stglucose ~ 1 + bs(min, df = 4) + (1 + bs(min, df = 4) | participant), 
                     data = pre_dat, 
                     family = gaussian())



p2 <- c(
  
               prior(normal(-1, 1.5), class = Intercept),  
               
               prior(normal(1, 1.5), class = b, coef = "bsmindfEQ41"),
               prior(normal(0.5, 1.5), class = b, coef = "bsmindfEQ42"),
               prior(normal(-1, 1.5), class = b, coef = "bsmindfEQ43"),
               prior(normal(-0.5, 1.5), class = b, coef = "bsmindfEQ44"),
  
            # The prior for the correlations between participant level regression parameters
               prior(lkj(1), class = cor),
               # The wigglyness SD, wigglyness is sampled from a exponential distribution
               prior(exponential(2), class = sd),
               # The prior for the residual variation
               prior(exponential(1), class = sigma)
               
               
  
) 


validate_prior(p2,
               formula = stglucose ~ 1 + bs(min, df = 4) + 
                 (1 + bs(min, df = 4) | participant),
               data = pre_dat, 
               family = gaussian())


m2_pp <- brm(stglucose ~ 1 + bs(min, df = 4) + 
                 (1 + bs(min, df = 4) | participant),
             # Priors (including comments)
             prior = p2,
             file = "fits/ogtt-analysis/m2_pp", # Save the model
             sample_prior = "only", # Sample only from the prior
             data = pre_dat, 
             family = gaussian(),
             chains = 4, 
             iter = 2000, 
             warmup = 1000, 
             control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95))

preds_prior <- predictions(m2_pp, newdata = expand_grid(min = seq(0, 120, 10), 
                                                       participant = c(1, 2, 3, 4)), 
                           allow_new_levels = TRUE)


posterior_draws(preds_prior) %>%
  filter(drawid %in% 1:500) %>%
  ggplot(aes(min, draw, group = paste(participant, drawid))) + 
  geom_line(alpha = 0.1) + 
  
  facet_wrap(~ participant) +
  
  labs(title = "Prior predictive simulation",
       x = "Sample time",
       y = "Glucose (standardized)") 


```


```{r}



m2 <- update(m2_pp, 
             newdata = pre_dat, 
             sample_prior = "no", # Sample from the posterior
             file = "fits/ogtt-analysis/m2", 
             iter = 4000, 
             warmup = 1000, 
             save_pars = save_pars(all = TRUE),
             cores = 4,
             control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95))



plot(m2)
print(m2)



```


```{r}

                  participant = pull(distinct(pre_dat,participant), participant)) 


preds <- predictions(m2, newdata = nd, allow_new_levels = TRUE) 


posterior_draws(preds) %>%
  filter(drawid %in% 1:500) %>%
  filter(participant %in% c("501", "503", "504", "506")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(min, draw, group = paste0(participant,drawid))) + 
  
  
  geom_line(alpha = 0.1, aes(color = as.factor(participant))) + 
  
  geom_point(data = filter(pre_dat, participant %in% c("501", "503", "504", "506")), 
             aes(min, stglucose, group = NULL, 
                 fill = as.factor(participant)), 
             alpha = 1, shape = 21, size = 2) +
  
  geom_smooth(method="lm", se=FALSE, color = "black", linetype = "dashed",
              aes(min, stglucose, group = participant),
             data = filter(pre_dat, participant %in% c("501", "503", "504", "506")), 
   formula =  y ~ splines::bs(x, df = 4)) +
  
  
  labs(title = "Posterior predictive simulation (Global and participant specific smooths)",
       subtitle = "Posterior draws as lines per participant, data as points",
       x = "Sample time (min)",
       y = "Glucose (Standardized units)") + 
  theme_classic()  +  facet_wrap(~ participant)
```

## Pre- to post-intervention data, two groups

```{r}

part_t2 <- AOData::idkeys %>%
  filter(completed != "t1") %>%
  pull(participant)



compl_dat <- glucose_dat %>%
  # Keep data only from time 1 and 2
  filter(time %in% c("T1", "T2")) %>%
  # Filter participants who have completed T2
  filter(participant %in% part_t2) %>%
  # Remove NAs -- might update this to allow for not completly missing data 
  # to be imputed
  filter(!is.na(glucose)) %>%
  # Standardize glucose measurements
  mutate(stglucose = (glucose - mean(glucose)) /sd(glucose)) %>%
  ## Add treatment variable
  inner_join(AOData::idkeys %>%
  select(participant, treat)) %>%
  ## Combine data into a single variable (time/treat)
  mutate(tx = paste(time, treat, sep = "_")) %>%
  print()



```


```{r}


get_prior(stglucose ~ 0 + tx + 
            bs(min, df = 4):tx + 
            (1 + bs(min, df = 4):time | participant), 
                     data = compl_dat, 
                     family = gaussian())



p3 <- c(
  
               prior(normal(-1, 1.5), class = b, coef = "txT1_ctrl"),  
                prior(normal(-1, 1.5), class = b, coef = "txT1_omega"),  
                prior(normal(-1, 1.5), class = b, coef = "txT2_ctrl"),  
                prior(normal(-1, 1.5), class = b, coef = "txT2_omega"),  
               
               
               # Group/time priors for the splines
               prior(normal(1, 1.5),    class = b, coef = "txT1_ctrl:bsmindfEQ41"),
               prior(normal(0.5, 1.5),  class = b, coef = "txT1_ctrl:bsmindfEQ42"),
               prior(normal(-1, 1.5),   class = b, coef = "txT1_ctrl:bsmindfEQ43"),
               prior(normal(-0.5, 1.5), class = b, coef = "txT1_ctrl:bsmindfEQ44"),
               
                 prior(normal(1, 1.5),  class = b, coef = "txT1_omega:bsmindfEQ41"),
               prior(normal(0.5, 1.5),  class = b, coef = "txT1_omega:bsmindfEQ42"),
               prior(normal(-1, 1.5),   class = b, coef = "txT1_omega:bsmindfEQ43"),
               prior(normal(-0.5, 1.5), class = b, coef = "txT1_omega:bsmindfEQ44"),
               
                 prior(normal(1, 1.5),  class = b, coef = "txT2_ctrl:bsmindfEQ41"),
               prior(normal(0.5, 1.5),  class = b, coef = "txT2_ctrl:bsmindfEQ42"),
               prior(normal(-1, 1.5),   class = b, coef = "txT2_ctrl:bsmindfEQ43"),
               prior(normal(-0.5, 1.5), class = b, coef = "txT2_ctrl:bsmindfEQ44"),
               
                 prior(normal(1, 1.5),  class = b, coef = "txT2_omega:bsmindfEQ41"),
               prior(normal(0.5, 1.5),  class = b, coef = "txT2_omega:bsmindfEQ42"),
               prior(normal(-1, 1.5),   class = b, coef = "txT2_omega:bsmindfEQ43"),
               prior(normal(-0.5, 1.5), class = b, coef = "txT2_omega:bsmindfEQ44"),
               # 
               prior(lkj(1), class = cor),
               # The wigglyness SD sampled from exponential distribution
               prior(exponential(2), class = sd),
               prior(exponential(1), class = sigma))
               
               
               

validate_prior(p3,
               stglucose ~ 0 + tx + 
            bs(min, df = 4):tx + 
            (1 + bs(min, df = 4):time | participant), 
                     data = compl_dat, 
                     family = gaussian())


m3_pp <- brm(stglucose ~ 0 + tx + 
            bs(min, df = 4):tx + 
            (1 + bs(min, df = 4):time | participant),
             # Priors
             prior = p3,
             file = "fits/ogtt-analysis/m3_pp", # Save the model
             sample_prior = "only", # Sample only from the prior
             data = compl_dat, 
             family = gaussian(),
             chains = 4, 
             iter = 2000, 
             warmup = 1000, 
             control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95))

## New data 

nd <- expand_grid(min = seq(0, 120, 10), 
                  participant = c(1, 2, 3, 4),
                  time = c("T1", "T2")) %>%
  mutate(treat = if_else(participant %in% c(1, 2), "ctrl", "omega"), 
         tx = paste(time, treat, sep = "_")) %>%
  print()



preds_prior <- predictions(m3_pp, newdata = nd, 
                           allow_new_levels = TRUE)


posterior_draws(preds_prior) %>%
  filter(drawid %in% 1:500) %>%
  ggplot(aes(min, draw,
             color = tx,
             group = paste(participant, drawid))) + 
  geom_line(alpha = 0.1) + 
  
  facet_grid(time ~ participant) +
  
  labs(title = "Prior predictive simulation",
       x = "Sample time",
       y = "Glucose (standardized)") 



```



```{r}



m3 <- update(m3_pp, 
             newdata = compl_dat, 
             sample_prior = "no", # Sample from the posterior
             file = "fits/ogtt-analysis/m3", 
             iter = 4000, 
             warmup = 1000, 
             cores = 4,
             control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95))



plot(m3)
print(m2)






```



```{r}






# Predictions

nd <- expand_grid(min = seq(0, 120, 5), 
                  time = c("T1", "T2"), 
                  treat = c("ctrl", "omega"), 
                  participant = NA) %>%
  mutate(tx = paste(time, treat, sep = "_")) %>%
  print()



preds <- predictions(m3, newdata = nd, re_formula = NA) 



comp_df <- posterior_draws(preds) %>%
  filter(drawid %in% 1:2000) %>%
  select(drawid, min, draw, tx, participant) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = tx, values_from = draw) %>%
  
  # Compare "groups" as within group differences between time points
  # Compare differences over time between groups (tx_contrast)
  mutate(ctrl = T2_ctrl - T1_ctrl, 
         omega = T2_omega - T1_omega, 
         tx_contrast = omega - ctrl) %>%
  
  pivot_longer(cols = T1_ctrl:tx_contrast) %>%
   
  print()

  
# Using the data we can calculate 95% credible intervals for the differences between groups.
  
m3_comp <- comp_df %>%  
  # Group the data frame by sample time
  group_by(min, name) %>%
  # ... and calculate summary statistics for the differences
  summarise(m = median(value, na.rm = TRUE), 
            l95 = quantile(value, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE), 
            u95 = quantile(value, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE), 
            l50 = quantile(value, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE), 
            u50 = quantile(value, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)) 

  
m3_comp %>%
  
  filter(name %in% c("T1_ctrl", "T1_omega", "T2_ctrl", "T2_omega")) %>%
  
  separate(name, into = c("time", "treat")) %>%

  ggplot(aes(min, m, fill = time)) + 
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = l95, ymax = u95), alpha = 0.2) +
   geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = l50, ymax = u50), alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_line() + 
  labs(x = "Sample time", y = "Blood glucose (standardized values)", 
       title = "Comparisons") + 
  facet_wrap(~ treat)


m3_comp %>%
  
  filter(name %in% c("ctrl", "omega")) %>%
  

  ggplot(aes(min, m, fill = name)) + 
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = l95, ymax = u95), alpha = 0.2) +
   geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = l50, ymax = u50), alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_line() + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, lty = 2) +
  labs(x = "Sample time", y = "Blood glucose (standardized values)", 
       title = "Comparisons")


m3_comp %>%
  
  filter(name %in% c("tx_contrast")) %>%
  

  ggplot(aes(min, m)) + 
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = l95, ymax = u95), alpha = 0.2, fill = "orchid1") +
   geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = l50, ymax = u50), alpha = 0.2, fill = "orchid1") +
  geom_line() + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, lty = 2) +
  labs(x = "Sample time", y = "Blood glucose (standardized values)", 
       title = "Comparisons")


```


### Effects of supplementation and training

```{r}
# Data set 

part_t4 <- AOData::idkeys %>%
  filter(completed == "t4") %>%
  pull(participant)



compl_train_dat <- glucose_dat %>%
  # Keep data only from time 1 and 2
  filter(time %in% c("T2", "T4")) %>%
  # Filter participants who have completed T2
  filter(participant %in% part_t4) %>%
  # Remove NAs -- might update this to allow for not completly missing data 
  # to be imputed
  filter(!is.na(glucose)) %>%
  # Standardize glucose measurements
  mutate(stglucose = (glucose - mean(glucose)) /sd(glucose)) %>%
  ## Add treatment variable
  inner_join(AOData::idkeys %>%
  select(participant, treat)) %>%
  ## Combine data into a single variable (time/treat)
  mutate(tx = paste(time, treat, sep = "_")) %>%
  print()






```



```{r}


get_prior(stglucose ~ 0 + tx + 
            bs(min, df = 4):tx + 
            (1 + bs(min, df = 4):time | participant), 
                     data = compl_train_dat, 
                     family = gaussian())



p4 <- c(
  
               prior(normal(-1, 1.5), class = b, coef = "txT2_ctrl"),  
                prior(normal(-1, 1.5), class = b, coef = "txT2_omega"),  
                prior(normal(-1, 1.5), class = b, coef = "txT4_ctrl"),  
                prior(normal(-1, 1.5), class = b, coef = "txT4_omega"),  
               
               
               # Group/time priors for the splines
               prior(normal(1, 1.5),    class = b, coef = "txT2_ctrl:bsmindfEQ41"),
               prior(normal(0.5, 1.5),  class = b, coef = "txT2_ctrl:bsmindfEQ42"),
               prior(normal(-1, 1.5),   class = b, coef = "txT2_ctrl:bsmindfEQ43"),
               prior(normal(-0.5, 1.5), class = b, coef = "txT2_ctrl:bsmindfEQ44"),
               
                 prior(normal(1, 1.5),  class = b, coef = "txT2_omega:bsmindfEQ41"),
               prior(normal(0.5, 1.5),  class = b, coef = "txT2_omega:bsmindfEQ42"),
               prior(normal(-1, 1.5),   class = b, coef = "txT2_omega:bsmindfEQ43"),

                 prior(normal(1, 1.5),  class = b, coef = "txT4_ctrl:bsmindfEQ41"),
               prior(normal(0.5, 1.5),  class = b, coef = "txT4_ctrl:bsmindfEQ42"),
               prior(normal(-1, 1.5),   class = b, coef = "txT4_ctrl:bsmindfEQ43"),
               prior(normal(-0.5, 1.5), class = b, coef = "txT4_ctrl:bsmindfEQ44"),
               
                 prior(normal(1, 1.5),  class = b, coef = "txT4_omega:bsmindfEQ41"),
               prior(normal(0.5, 1.5),  class = b, coef = "txT4_omega:bsmindfEQ42"),
               prior(normal(-1, 1.5),   class = b, coef = "txT4_omega:bsmindfEQ43"),
               prior(normal(-0.5, 1.5), class = b, coef = "txT4_omega:bsmindfEQ44"),
               # 
               prior(lkj(1), class = cor),
               # The wigglyness SD sampled from exponential distribution
               prior(exponential(2), class = sd),
               prior(exponential(1), class = sigma))
               
               
               

validate_prior(p4,
               stglucose ~ 0 + tx + 
            bs(min, df = 4):tx + 
            (1 + bs(min, df = 4):time | participant), 
                     data = compl_train_dat,

             data = compl_train_dat,
```

```{r}






# Predictions

nd <- expand_grid(min = seq(0, 120, 5),

                  participant = NA) %>%
  mutate(tx = paste(time, treat, sep = "_")) %>%
  print()



preds <- predictions(m4, newdata = nd, re_formula = NA) 



comp_df <- posterior_draws(preds) %>%
  filter(drawid %in% 1:2000) %>%

  pivot_wider(names_from = tx, values_from = draw) %>%
  
  # Compare "groups" as within group differences between time points

  mutate(ctrl = T4_ctrl - T2_ctrl, 
         omega = T4_omega - T2_omega,

# Using the data we can calculate 95% credible intervals for the differences between groups.
  
sum_comp <- comp_df %>%

  group_by(min, name) %>%
  # ... and calculate summary statistics for the differences
  summarise(m = median(value, na.rm = TRUE),

            u95 = quantile(value, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE), 
            l50 = quantile(value, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),

  filter(name %in% c("T2_omega", 
                   "T4_omega",

                   "T4_ctrl")) %>%
  separate(name, into = c("time", "treat")) %>%

  ggplot(aes(min, m, fill = time)) +

   geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = l50, ymax = u50), alpha = 0.2) +

  labs(x = "Sample time", y = "Blood glucose (standardized values)") + 
  facet_wrap(~ treat)


sum_comp %>%
  filter(name %in% c("omega", 
                    
                   "ctrl")) %>%

  ggplot(aes(min, m, fill = name)) + 
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = l95, ymax = u95), alpha = 0.2) +
   geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = l50, ymax = u50), alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_line(aes(color = name)) + 
  labs(x = "Sample time", y = "Blood glucose (standardized values)") + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, lty = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~ name)


sum_comp %>%
  filter(name %in% c("tx_contrast")) %>%
  
  
  
  ggplot(aes(min, m), fill = "limegreen") + 
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = l95, ymax = u95), alpha = 0.2, fill = "limegreen") +
   geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = l50, ymax = u50), alpha = 0.2, fill = "limegreen") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, lty = 2) +
  geom_line() + 
  labs(x = "Sample time", y = "Blood glucose (standardized values)")
```

## All time points


```{r}
# Data set 

part_t4 <- AOData::idkeys %>%
  filter(completed == "t4") %>%
  pull(participant)



compl_train_dat <- glucose_dat %>%
  # Keep data only from time 1 and 2
  filter(time %in% c("T1", "T2", "T4")) %>%
  # Filter participants who have completed T2
  filter(participant %in% part_t4) %>%
  # Remove NAs -- might update this to allow for not completly missing data 
  # to be imputed
  filter(!is.na(glucose)) %>%
  # Standardize glucose measurements
  mutate(stglucose = (glucose - mean(glucose)) /sd(glucose)) %>%
  ## Add treatment variable
  inner_join(AOData::idkeys %>%
  select(participant, treat)) %>%
  ## Combine data into a single variable (time/treat)
  mutate(tx = paste(time, treat, sep = "_")) %>%
  print()






```



```{r}


get_prior(stglucose ~ 0 + tx + 
            bs(min, df = 4):tx + 
            (1 + bs(min, df = 4):time | participant), 
                     data = compl_train_dat, 
                     family = gaussian())



p5 <- c(
                prior(normal(-1, 1.5), class = b, coef = "txT1_ctrl"),  
                prior(normal(-1, 1.5), class = b, coef = "txT1_omega"),  
                prior(normal(-1, 1.5), class = b, coef = "txT2_ctrl"),  
                prior(normal(-1, 1.5), class = b, coef = "txT2_omega"),  
                prior(normal(-1, 1.5), class = b, coef = "txT4_ctrl"),  
                prior(normal(-1, 1.5), class = b, coef = "txT4_omega"),  
               
               
               # Group/time priors for the splines
               
               prior(normal(1, 1.5),    class = b, coef = "txT1_ctrl:bsmindfEQ41"),
               prior(normal(0.5, 1.5),  class = b, coef = "txT1_ctrl:bsmindfEQ42"),
               prior(normal(-1, 1.5),   class = b, coef = "txT1_ctrl:bsmindfEQ43"),
               prior(normal(-0.5, 1.5), class = b, coef = "txT1_ctrl:bsmindfEQ44"),
               
                 prior(normal(1, 1.5),  class = b, coef = "txT1_omega:bsmindfEQ41"),
               prior(normal(0.5, 1.5),  class = b, coef = "txT1_omega:bsmindfEQ42"),
               prior(normal(-1, 1.5),   class = b, coef = "txT1_omega:bsmindfEQ43"),
               prior(normal(-0.5, 1.5), class = b, coef = "txT1_omega:bsmindfEQ44"),
               
               
               
               prior(normal(1, 1.5),    class = b, coef = "txT2_ctrl:bsmindfEQ41"),
               prior(normal(0.5, 1.5),  class = b, coef = "txT2_ctrl:bsmindfEQ42"),
               prior(normal(-1, 1.5),   class = b, coef = "txT2_ctrl:bsmindfEQ43"),
               prior(normal(-0.5, 1.5), class = b, coef = "txT2_ctrl:bsmindfEQ44"),
               
                 prior(normal(1, 1.5),  class = b, coef = "txT2_omega:bsmindfEQ41"),
               prior(normal(0.5, 1.5),  class = b, coef = "txT2_omega:bsmindfEQ42"),
               prior(normal(-1, 1.5),   class = b, coef = "txT2_omega:bsmindfEQ43"),
               prior(normal(-0.5, 1.5), class = b, coef = "txT2_omega:bsmindfEQ44"),
               
                 prior(normal(1, 1.5),  class = b, coef = "txT4_ctrl:bsmindfEQ41"),
               prior(normal(0.5, 1.5),  class = b, coef = "txT4_ctrl:bsmindfEQ42"),
               prior(normal(-1, 1.5),   class = b, coef = "txT4_ctrl:bsmindfEQ43"),
               prior(normal(-0.5, 1.5), class = b, coef = "txT4_ctrl:bsmindfEQ44"),
               
                 prior(normal(1, 1.5),  class = b, coef = "txT4_omega:bsmindfEQ41"),
               prior(normal(0.5, 1.5),  class = b, coef = "txT4_omega:bsmindfEQ42"),
               prior(normal(-1, 1.5),   class = b, coef = "txT4_omega:bsmindfEQ43"),
               prior(normal(-0.5, 1.5), class = b, coef = "txT4_omega:bsmindfEQ44"),
               # 
               prior(lkj(1), class = cor),
               # The wigglyness SD sampled from exponential distribution
               prior(exponential(2), class = sd),
               prior(exponential(1), class = sigma))
               
               
               

validate_prior(p5,
               stglucose ~ 0 + tx + 
            bs(min, df = 4):tx + 
            (1 + bs(min, df = 4):time | participant), 
                     data = compl_train_dat, 
                     family = gaussian())


m5_pp <- brm(stglucose ~ 0 + tx + 
            bs(min, df = 4):tx + 
            (1 + bs(min, df = 4):time | participant),
             # Priors
             prior = p5,
             file = "fits/ogtt-analysis/m5_pp", # Save the model
             sample_prior = "only", # Sample only from the prior
             data = compl_train_dat, 
             family = gaussian(),
             chains = 4, 
             iter = 2000, 
             warmup = 1000, 
             control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95))

## New data
```

```{r}






# Predictions

nd <- expand_grid(min = seq(0, 120, 5), 
                  time = c("T1", "T2", "T4"), 
                  treat = c("ctrl", "omega"), 
                  participant = NA) %>%
  mutate(tx = paste(time, treat, sep = "_")) %>%
  print()



preds <- predictions(m5, newdata = nd, re_formula = NA) 



comp_df <- posterior_draws(preds) %>%
  filter(drawid %in% 1:2000) %>%
  select(drawid, min, draw, tx, participant) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = tx, values_from = draw) %>%
  
  # Compare "groups" as within group differences between time points
  # Compare differences over time between groups (tx_contrast)
  mutate(ctrl_train = T4_ctrl - T2_ctrl, 
         omega_train = T4_omega - T2_omega,
         ctrl_suppl = T2_ctrl - T1_ctrl,
         omega_suppl = T2_omega - T1_omega,
         ctrl_suppl_train = T4_ctrl - T1_ctrl,
         omega_suppl_train = T4_omega - T1_omega,
         tx_suppl = omega_suppl - ctrl_suppl,
         tx_train = omega_train - ctrl_train, 
         tx_suppl_train = omega_suppl_train - ctrl_suppl_train) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = T1_ctrl:tx_suppl_train) %>%
   
  print()

  
# Using the data we can calculate 95% credible intervals for the differences between groups.
  
sum_comp <- comp_df %>%  
  # Group the data frame by sample time
  group_by(min, name) %>%
  # ... and calculate summary statistics for the differences
  summarise(m = median(value, na.rm = TRUE), 
            l95 = quantile(value, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE), 
            u95 = quantile(value, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE), 
            l50 = quantile(value, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE), 
            u50 = quantile(value, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)) 
  
  
sum_comp %>%
  filter(name %in% c("T2_omega", 
                   "T4_omega", 
                   "T2_ctrl", 
                   "T4_ctrl", 
                   "T1_omega", 
                   "T1_ctrl")) %>%
  separate(name, into = c("time", "treat")) %>%

  ggplot(aes(min, m, fill = time)) + 
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = l95, ymax = u95), alpha = 0.2) +
   geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = l50, ymax = u50), alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_line(aes(color = time)) + 
  labs(x = "Sample time", y = "Blood glucose (standardized values)") + 
  facet_wrap(~ treat)


sum_comp %>%
  filter(name %in% c("omega_suppl_train", 
                    
                   "ctrl_suppl_train")) %>%

  ggplot(aes(min, m, fill = name)) + 
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = l95, ymax = u95), alpha = 0.2) +
   geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = l50, ymax = u50), alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_line(aes(color = name)) + 
  labs(x = "Sample time", y = "Blood glucose (standardized values)") + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, lty = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~ name)


sum_comp %>%
  filter(name %in% c("tx_suppl_train", "tx_suppl", "tx_train")) %>%
  
  
  
  ggplot(aes(min, m), fill = "limegreen") + 
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = l95, ymax = u95), alpha = 0.2, fill = "limegreen") +
   geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = l50, ymax = u50), alpha = 0.2, fill = "limegreen") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, lty = 2) +
  geom_line() + 
  labs(x = "Sample time", y = "Blood glucose (standardized values)") +
  facet_wrap(~ name)
```

### BMI and glucose tolerance test


```{r}
library(splines)

pre_dat <- glucose_dat %>%
  filter(time == "T1") %>%
  inner_join(AOData::idkeys) %>%
  
  select(participant:treat, sex, bmi) %>%
  
  filter(!is.na(glucose)) %>%
  mutate(stglucose = (glucose - mean(glucose)) / sd(glucose)) %>%
  
  print()




get_prior(stglucose ~ 1 + bs(min, df = 4):bmi + (1 + bs(min, df = 4) | participant), 
                     data = pre_dat, 
                     family = gaussian())



p6 <- c(
  
               prior(normal(-1, 1.5), class = Intercept),  
               
               prior(normal(1, 1.5), class = b, coef = "bsmindfEQ41:bmi"),
               prior(normal(0.5, 1.5), class = b, coef = "bsmindfEQ42:bmi"),
               prior(normal(-1, 1.5), class = b, coef = "bsmindfEQ43:bmi"),
               prior(normal(-0.5, 1.5), class = b, coef = "bsmindfEQ44:bmi"),
  
            # The prior for the correlations between participant level regression parameters
               prior(lkj(1), class = cor),
               # The wigglyness SD, wigglyness is sampled from a exponential distribution
               prior(exponential(2), class = sd),
               # The prior for the residual variation
               prior(exponential(1), class = sigma)
               
               
  
) 


validate_prior(p6,
               formula = stglucose ~ 1 + bs(min, df = 4):bmi + (1 + bs(min, df = 4) | participant),
               data = pre_dat, 
               family = gaussian())


m6_pp <- brm(stglucose ~ 1 + bs(min, df = 4):bmi + (1 + bs(min, df = 4) | participant),
             # Priors (including comments)
             prior = p6,
             file = "fits/ogtt-analysis/m6_pp", # Save the model
             sample_prior = "only", # Sample only from the prior
             data = pre_dat, 
             family = gaussian(),
             chains = 4, 
             iter = 2000, 
             warmup = 1000, 
             control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95))

preds_prior <- predictions(m6_pp, newdata = expand_grid(min = seq(0, 120, 10),
                                                        bmi = c(min(pre_dat$bmi), 
                                                                max(pre_dat$bmi)),
                                                       participant = c(1, 2, 3, 4)), 
                           allow_new_levels = TRUE)


posterior_draws(preds_prior) %>%
  filter(drawid %in% 1:500) %>%
  ggplot(aes(min, draw, group = paste(participant, drawid, bmi))) + 
  geom_line(alpha = 0.1) + 
  
  facet_wrap(~ participant) +
  
  labs(title = "Prior predictive simulation",
       x = "Sample time",
       y = "Glucose (standardized)") 


```
